chunks.spoken: You can't read your users' chats. So logless sends in an agent that writes code, and runs it in a sandbox on Vultr.

chunks.caption: 5,000 real chats, grouped by GLM on Vultr.
chunks.spoken: Here are five thousand real conversations, grouped by GLM on Vultr.

chunks.caption: 300 more arrive.
chunks.spoken: Three hundred new ones come in.

chunks.caption: TypeSafe Jev routes each live, about {rate} a second.
chunks.spoken: TypeSafe Jev routes each one live, about {rate} a second.

chunks.caption: Privacy gate passes; the map republishes.
chunks.spoken: The privacy gate checks them, and the map updates.

chunks.caption: Coding: under a fifth of chats, over a quarter of friction.
chunks.spoken: Coding is under a fifth of the chats, but over a quarter of the friction.

chunks.caption: The agent plans, then writes two independent programs without seeing a row.
chunks.spoken: The agent makes a plan, and writes two separate programs, without ever seeing the data.

chunks.caption: Each runs in its own gVisor container on a keyless VM; both must agree and pass the gate.
chunks.spoken: Each runs in its own gee-visor container, on a machine with no keys. They have to agree, and pass the gate.

chunks.caption: Every answer ships with a receipt.
chunks.spoken: And every answer comes with a receipt.

chunks.caption: A runaway program: killed at two seconds.
chunks.spoken: Now, hostile code. A runaway program gets killed at two seconds.

chunks.caption: rm -rf /: read-only root, deletions refused.
chunks.spoken: R M, dash R F, slash? It hits a read-only root, and the deletes are refused.

chunks.caption: A per-person export: rejected by the gate.
chunks.spoken: And a per-person export? The gate rejects it.

chunks.caption: {targets} evaluation targets met; 0 canary leaks.
chunks.spoken: {targets} evaluation targets met, and zero canary leaks.
